Targeted Relief for Better Patient Outcomes

A cornerstone of our Pain Treatment portfolio, StimRouter ® provides relief from chronic peripheral nerve pain.* This non-drug, permanent solution delivers gentle electrical pulses to target pain at its source. Giving patients control over their pain, StimRouter can improve activity and overall quality of life.
*StimRouter is not intended to treat pain in the craniofacial region.

raw_blocks: Back to Products Surgical Solutions

At Bioventus, we understand the extraordinary potential of orthobiologics in bone formation. We are solely focused on orthobiologic product performance and are committed to deliver best-in-class solutions that meet the requirements of surgeons and their patients, across a broad range of risk factors, procedures, and hardware selection.

Our comprehensive portfolio of surgical solutions offers a wide variety of products to meet the needs of any surgeon and their patients, across a broad range of patient needs, procedures, and costs. Learn more about our Allograft , Cell & Marrow , and Synthetic offerings.

We also have a suite of minimally invasive therapeutic ultrasonic technologies based on the neXus ® Ultrasonic Surgical Aspirator System optimized for hard and soft tissue removal. A solution providing more power and more versatility, while simultaneously controlling cost. Handpieces used by surgeons that are powered by the neXus system include BoneScalpel ® and BoneScalpel Access ® for osteotomies and SonaStar ® for precision removal of soft tissue.

raw_blocks: Innovations for Active Healing that Enhance the Body’s Ability to Heal

Bioventus is a global leader of innovations for active healing. Through a combination of internal product development, product/business acquisition, and distribution agreements, we will bring to market products which address a growing need for clinically effective, cost efficient, minimally invasive medical treatments, that engage and enhance the body’s natural healing processes.

Established in 2012, Bioventus Inc. (Nasdaq: BVS) is headquartered in Durham, NC. The company has more than 1,200 employees worldwide through its offices in Memphis, TN; Valencia, CA; Farmingdale, NY and Mississauga, Ontario, Canada; its international headquarters in Hoofddorp, The Netherlands. In 2024, products from Bioventus helped more than 1,400,000 people regain active lifestyles.
Established in 2012 in North Carolina
Employs more than 1,200 people worldwide
Works in more than 50 countries throughout the world

Our mission is to partner with the health care community to deliver innovative medical devices and meet the evolving needs of patients, allowing them to resume and enjoy active lives. To this end, we develop and/or market clinically proven and cost-effective product offerings that are backed by clinical data. The products of Bioventus are known for their safety, innovation, and effectiveness.
The company focuses its medical product development around three segments: Pain Treatments, Restorative Therapies and Surgical Solutions.

The Pain Treatments and Joint Preservation products treat the chronic pain associated with osteoarthritis and peripheral nerve stimulation (PNS) products. These therapies relieve pain and help bring mobility back to the patient.

Restorative Therapies products for minimally invasive fracture treatments. These therapies may also reduce the need for invasive procedures, leading to more cost-effective outcomes than previously possible.

Our Surgical Solutions advance the science and surgical performance of biologics with a comprehensive portfolio of clinically efficacious and cost effective bone graft substitutes and a suite of minimally invasive therapeutic ultrasonic technologies optimized for hard and soft tissue removal.
Our offerings will expand to meet market demand to improve healing and contain healthcare costs.
